phases.description: THEO waits at the window, looking at MARA off frame-right
the shutter rattles up off screen and the green lamp light washes across THEO's face as he straightens, still looking at MARA

questions.question: Viewer reads: the window opens for him - carried by: THEO
0-1.5s SETUP: does this happen on screen - THEO waits at the window, looking at MARA off frame-right?
1.5-4s ACTION: does this happen on screen - the shutter rattles up off screen and the green lamp light washes across THEO's face as he straightens, still looking at MARA?
Happens exactly once (not repeated or looped): the shutter rattles up off screen
THEO: does the face/body read as held breath, then relief (restrained)? Must NOT read as: triumph.
Planned size CLOSE, EYE_LEVEL, STATIC: does the take match?

First frame matches state SC04_g2: Continues from the previous shot: MARA seated on her stool behind the counter, frame-right; THEO at the window, frame-left; the shutter: pulled down, its bottom edge resting on the brass shutter catches, a face-high gap left above the counter; the jar: on the counter, full of coins.

Last frame matches state SC04_g3: Continues from the previous shot: MARA seated on her stool behind the counter, frame-right; THEO at the window, frame-left; the shutter: up; the jar: on the counter, full of coins.
Identity, wardrobe, set and light stable; no morphing, extra limbs, text artefacts or flicker.
Motion is physically plausible and smooth (full clip, not stills).
Is the place where MARA stands kept out of frame (never shown empty), and do THEO's eyes go just past the lens to frame-right?
Does THEO look at MARA and never into the lens?
Do MARA and THEO stay on their own sides (clerk booth (staff side) / public hall (customer side)) the whole clip?

instructions: Fill checks[] (result, severity on FAIL, level, evidence, reviewer human:<id>), then `film.py review --film DIR --ingest FILE`. Leave a group UNASSESSED if you did not look. Questions with an id (REL_*) need a short answer in the group check's answers{id: text}; without it the take cannot be ACCEPTED.
